english.title: The Dead Fields
english.objective:
Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields.

When Nightlash appears, kill her.

Bring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
english.detail:
Our initial scouting reports of Silverpine show the rot hides have a base at an old farm to the north, the Dead Fields.  We have sent small assaults against them, but each time they are reinforced by the banshee Nightlash, who uses her magic to rout our forces.

We want Nightlash destroyed.

Go to the Dead Fields and assault the rot hides.  If you don't see Nightlash then kill the rot hides until she appears, then defeat her.

Her essence will turn to dust.  Bring me that dust as proof.
english.progress: Have you defeated Nightlash, <name>?  Our success against the rot hides depends on her destruction!
english.complete:
I heard of your successful raid against the rot hides, <name>, and this essence is proof of Nightlash's death.

The Scourge have lost ground this day. Your value to the Forsaken grows.

english.title: The Decrepit Ferry
english.objective:
Go to the Decrepit Ferry.

Search for the reason the Scourge are there.
english.detail:
<Name>, we've discovered a new hive for the Scourge: the Decrepit Ferry.  The ferry lies east of the Sepulcher, and is heavily patrolled by rot hides and other undead.

There must be a reason for the Scourge's occupation of the area.  Go to the Decrepit Ferry and find out why the Scourge are there.
english.complete:
Heaped within this boat is a pile of wrapped corpses. And looking east across Lordamere Lake, an opposing dock on Fenris Isle can be seen.

The fate of the corpses must lie on Fenris Isle.

english.title: Rot Hide Clues
english.objective: Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
english.detail:
Among the corpses a hand protrudes, unwrapped.  It is the hand of a woman, pockmarked from the plague but relatively fresh.  

On the hand is a ring.  Removing the ring and inspecting it reveals an engraving:

"For Deliah"
english.progress: <name>. You return, so I assume your investigations bore fruit?
english.complete:
You say that this ring was worn by a woman, recently killed?

The only nearby source of such a body would be the mass graves in Tirisfal. The Rot Hide Gnolls must be taking those corpses to Fenris Isle!

english.title: Rot Hide Ichor
english.objective: Bring 8 bottles of rot hide ichor to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
english.detail:
Before we launch an assault on Fenris Isle, we must determine who is behind the rot hide gnolls.  Our apothecaries believe their origin lies within the strange fluid that flows through their bodies.

Go to Fenris Isle, east of the Decrepit Ferry, and collect rot hide ichor from the gnolls you find there.  Bring it to Apothecary Renferrel, stationed outside the Sepulcher.
english.progress: Do you have the rot hide ichor, <name>?
english.complete:
Very good. This ichor will help us understand the nature of the rot hides, and may show us their weakness...

...if they have one.

english.title: Rot Hide Origins
english.objective: Bring the Sample Ichor to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
english.detail:
I have reduced the ichor you brought me and separated it into its base components.  My findings are not conclusive, but I have determined that warlock and necromantic magics were used in the ichor's creation.

While I continue to study the ichor, I want you to take a sample to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.  Bethor is not an apothecary, but his knowledge of magic may help to unravel the mystery of the rot hides.

Go.  You will find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
english.progress: My studies require great concentration. So I hope your visit is not a frivolous one.
english.complete:
This substance is laced with powerful spells, some of which I have not seen for a long, long time...

One moment -- I must invoke a spell of divination...

english.title: Thule Ravenclaw
english.objective: Bring Bethor's Scroll to Apothecary Renferrel at the Silverpine Sepulcher.
english.detail:
This Ichor was crafted by an old colleague of mine: Thule Ravenclaw.  He was a young, promising mage before the great war, but when the Lich King rose to power, he betrayed his brethren and allied with the Scourge.

I did not realize he still lives, nor that he leads the Rot Hides in their forays against us!

I know many of his spells, and can help concoct a potion to counter them.  Take this scroll back to Apothecary Renferrel.  It has the incantations needed for the potion.
english.progress: Greetings, <name>. What did Bethor have to say?
english.complete: This scroll is laced with powerful magic. I've never used such forces in a potion ... it will be a powerful mixture, and should serve you well should you attack Thule in his stronghold on Fenris Isle.

english.title: Report to Hadrec
english.objective: Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
english.detail: Before you launch an assault on Fenris Isle, report to High Executor Hadrec.  He may have additional information or equipment you'll need.
english.complete:
If what Bethor says is true then Thule Ravenclaw is a force that must be dealt with, and dealt with soon.

To aid in this task, you may take something from our arsenal here...

english.title: Border Crossings
english.objective: Retrieve the contents of one of the Dalaran wizards' crates. You will find Pyrewood Village to the south.
english.detail:
As you may know, the town of Ambermill remains a source of human opposition, mainly through the support they receive from the wizards of Dalaran.

I don't know what their plan is, but for them to show interest in a backwater village like Ambermill indicates that it must have some greater importance.

They've been shipping crates by the wagon from Hillsbrad. Many of those supplies end up at a small camp north of Pyrewood Village. Retrieve the contents of a crate and return them to me.
english.complete:
<Prying open the lid of the crate, you find an assortment of carefully-packed objects. On the top of the crate lies a bundle of maps, yellowing with age, that appear to depict Silverpine Forest and other parts of western Lordaeron.

Underneath the maps is a mysterious-looking magical pendant.>

english.title: Maps and Runes
english.objective: Bring the strange pendant to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
english.detail: <You quickly remove the pendant from the crate and replace the lid.>
english.progress: Have you learned anything useful, <name>?
english.complete:
Maps and this... pendant, hm? Interesting.

It is obvious that the Dalaran wizards are interested in Ambermill for some purpose, but still, their aim is hidden to me.

Perhaps Dalar will know something of their use.

english.title: Ambermill Investigations
english.objective: Obtain 8 Dalaran Pendants for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
english.detail:
Dalar is attempting to locate the source of the wizards' spellcasting. For now, we'll have to slow their progress in any way we can...

The conjurers, mages and protectors are no doubt carrying the pendants. Remove and retrieve them.

Take the main road south and the eastern fork into Ambermill.
english.progress: We must hurry, their plans must not come to fruition, or we may lose our hold on Silverpine Forest.
english.complete:
Dalar has found that the weaving is quite far along, despite the setback.

A wizard of great power is guiding the magic energy. He must be stopped quickly.

english.title: Dalar's Analysis
english.objective: Take the rune-inscribed pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
english.detail: Take the pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver, perhaps he can shed some light on the wizards' plans.
english.progress: Yes, <class>? What is it?
english.complete:
Interesting, more machinations of the Kirin Tor, it would seem. This is a powerful artifact. It was used frequently by powerful wizards of the Kirin Tor to channel magical energies.

That they are delivering so many to Ambermill indicates that they must be undergoing a project of some magnitude.

I will see if I can pierce their shields and ascertain their intent.

english.title: Dalaran's Intentions
english.objective: Speak with Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
english.detail:
Of course! How could I have forgotten?

Ambermill was one of the sites earmarked by the Kirin Tor, noted because it houses a dormant ley energy node. The wizards must be planning to reactivate the node and use its energies for some greater purpose.

We cannot allow this to happen...

It will take a great amount of power to activate the area's ley energies, we can stall them by taking the pendants away from the wizards.

Relay this information to Allister, he will decide a course of action.
english.complete:
Ill news you bring, <name>. If Dalar is correct--and I've no reason to believe he isn't--we must move quickly.

I must confer with him on our plan of attack. But in the meanwhile we will have to delay their progress.

english.title: A Recipe For Death
english.objective: Collect 6 Grizzled Bear Hearts and 6 samples of Skittering Blood and deliver them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
english.detail:
Arthas's numbers are overwhelming. But with a New Plague we could eradicate both the Scourge Army and the Human infestation once and for all.

My studies have proven that spider blood combined with a toxin derived from a grizzled bear heart results in a deadly elixir. Collect samples from the spiders in the Skittering Dark to the northwest and from the bears wandering throughout Silverpine Forest. Deliver the reagents to Master Apothecary Faranell of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity.
english.progress: Hail, <class>. What business do you have with the Royal Apothecary Society?
english.complete: How good of Apothecary Renferrel to send you to me, <name>. These samples will indeed prove useful to the cause. I will begin studying their toxic and contaminable properties at once.

english.title: A Recipe For Death
english.objective: Retrieve Apothecary Berard's journal from Pyrewood Village and take it to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
english.detail:
You can be of further service to the Royal Apothecary Society, <Name>.

When Arugal cast his wretched magic on the forest, he cursed one of our most promising members, Apothecary Berard.  Now a mindless servant of Arugal, Berard is useless to us.  But his findings might prove to be of worth.  He was studying an ancient plague that killed off all the aquatic life in Lake Lordamere ages ago.

Retrieve Berard's Journal from his study in the Pyrewood Village Inn and take it to Apothecary Renferrel.
english.progress: I see you are back, <name>.
english.complete: Apothecary Berard's journal! Why you are quite brave, <name>. Now let's see what Berard was up to before he went mad. . .

english.title: A Recipe For Death
english.objective: Bring 6 samples of Lake Creeper Moss, 6 samples of Lake Skulker Moss and a Hardened Tumor to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
english.progress: What brings you back to the Undercity, <name>?
english.complete:
Such a blow to the Royal Apothecary Society to lose Berard.  But through your hard work and Apothecary Renferrel's diligent research Berard's studies will still be useful to The Dark Lady's plight.

We are on the cusp of something great here, <name>.  If you were not so skilled in the ways of combat I would try to recruit you for membership in the Society.
english.detail:
According to Berard's Journal the moss from Lake Skulkers and Creepers might prove useful for our quest to brew a new plague.  Those beasts dwell on the islands in Lake Lordamere to the east.

He also mentions a very rare Hardened Tumor that he discovered on a Vile Fin murloc.  Apparently the tumor is so rare Berard was only able to obtain one.

Collect samples of the moss as well as the rare Hardened Tumor and take them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

english.title: Supplying the Sepulcher
english.objective: Bring Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.
english.detail:
Executor Hadrec asked me to take stock of our equipment at the Sepulcher.  With the Scourge, and worse, lurking in the woods, he doesn't want the Deathguards to lack gear they might need.

I found that we are, in general, well stocked, but we do need more weapons to replace those lost in the field.

Here is a requisition order of what is needed, for the weapon dealer Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.  Take the order to our bat master, Karos Razok, and speak with him about transport to the Undercity.
english.progress: You appear to be on official business...
english.complete: Ah, an order for supplies.  You will want to take this to the Undercity, no doubt.  And quickly, for the Sepulcher must not be left under stocked.

english.objective: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.
english.detail:
I have placed the Sepulcher's supplies into this crate.  If you have already visited the Sepulcher and spoken with their bat master, then you may ride a bat back to him.

Speak with the Undercity's bat master, Michael Garrett.  He can provide you with a bat to the Sepulcher.
english.progress: If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.
english.complete: This crate must reach the Sepulcher in Silverpine? That is easily done; our bats fly there daily.

english.title: Ride to the Undercity
english.objective: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.
english.progress: I keep my weapons in top condition.  They are cleaned and ready for use.
english.complete: An order from the Sepulcher?  Very well.  It is an honor to serve those who serve our Dark Lady.
english.detail:
One of my bats can take you to the Undercity, for a small fee.  Speak with me again when you are ready so that we may arrange your transport.

You will find Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.  That is the same quarter where my bat will land.

english.title: Return to Podrig
english.objective: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.
english.detail:
The bat master in the Sepulcher is Karos Razok.  If you have already met him, then I can give you a bat to fly back to him.

Our bats will always fly to the Undercity, but to travel to more remote locales their rider must first visit the area and speak with its bat master.

You have met Karos in the Sepulcher, so you may now fly bats there.  Speak with me again when you are ready.
english.progress: <name>, you return. Do you have our supplies from the Undercity?
english.complete:
Good work, <name>. These weapons will ensure our Deathguards don't get caught unprepared.

You have done a valuable service for our Dark Lady.

english.title: Escorting Erland
english.objective: Escort Erland through the wolves, to Rane Yorick.
english.detail:
The wolves outside won't leave, and they eye me evilly every time I step foot out that door.  They must be incredibly hungry to think I'm worth eating.

I have to report to my teammate, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick.  And to get to Rane, I'll need help against those wolves.

Please escort me!  And there are a lot of wolves out there, so we'll have a better chance if you have friends who can help...
english.progress: Please be brief.  There is much danger about and we cannot stand idle in conversation.
english.complete: Thank you for the aid, <name>. I had feared Erland was overcome by the dangers of Silverpine. With your help, I see that he has not.

english.title: The Deathstalkers' Report
english.objective: Bring the Deathstalker Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
english.detail: Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible.  It has information that is vital to the Forsaken's occupation of Silverpine.
english.progress: Did you discover the fate of the Deathstalkers?
english.complete:
I hadn't accounted for the level of Scourge presence we've seen in Silverpine Forest, nor for the troubles our Deathstalkers have had in their scouting efforts.

Your aid to our Deathstalkers was invaluable, <name>. And you will be commended.

english.title: The Engraved Ring
english.objective: Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
english.detail:
If you want to find the husband or beloved who gave Deliah her ring... then speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.  He should have records of recent deaths and, with luck, can discover who Deliah is.

But I wouldn't hope.  Whoever gave her the ring is probably dead.  Or if he's undead he probably no longer cares about Deliah.
english.progress: Hello, <name>. What brings you back to Brill?
english.complete:
A Deliah did live in Brill not long ago. She was buried in the mass grave but if what you say is true, then the Rot Hide Gnolls must have stolen her body and taken it to Silverpine.

The Rot Hides, like all the Scourge, must be destroyed. I trust you are taking steps to make that happen.

english.title: Raleigh and the Undercity
english.objective: Bring Deliah's Ring to Raleigh.
english.detail:
Deliah had a husband, Raleigh, who now dwells in the Undercity.  If the Deliah who lived in Brill is the one who owned this ring, then Raleigh will know.

Raleigh is in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.
english.progress: Do I know you?
english.complete:
Yes, this ring was my wife's. Her fate was the fate of all who fail to endure these harsh times. I feel nothing for her death, nor for the story you tell of her body's abduction.

Such feelings have long since grown cold within me. But desire does still burn in my dead heart, <name>.

Desire for revenge.

english.title: Resting in Pieces
english.objective: Bring Alaric's Head to his grave.
english.detail:
You don't look like a rot hide.  Good.  I had lost hope...

My name is Alaric, and I was once Thule's head servant and bodyguard.  He used his magic to "protect" me from the Plague of Undeath, but instead his spell gave me an unlife from which I cannot escape.  And after creating the cursed rot hide gnolls, Thule beheaded me... and gave my head to the gnolls as a plaything!

Please, take me to my body.  I believe the gnolls buried it here in Fenris Keep, near the stable, in an unmarked grave.
english.progress: This grave was hastily dug.
english.complete: Thank you, <name>. I had feared the Gnolls destroyed my body. It is good to know they did not.

english.title: The Hidden Niche
english.objective: Take Alaric to the hidden alcove.
english.detail:
I know of a hidden niche within the keep that holds an item dear to Thule, and his old colleagues.  It also holds something you might find useful.  Take me there!

The alcove is in the southwestern tower of the keep, behind a dusty shelf.

Take my body, but leave my boots.  They never fit me anyway...
english.progress: This is the spot! Bring me closer...
english.complete:
There we are, it's open. Leave me here. I spent the best days of my life in this keep, and the thought of resting within its walls gives me comfort.

Be sure to close the alcove tight - I don't want those Rot Hides to find me.

Oh, and take this. You've earned it.
